failure_observation: Failing generations (e.g. gsm8k_train_2558 finds 11 within ~1500 tokens, gsm8k_train_1506) never emit </think> (token 248069); they loop in self-doubt ('Wait', 're-read') until the 32768 cutoff. Successful runs emit </think> after a concluding line ('Okay, ready to write.\n', 'I will write the response now.\n').
hypothesis: Neurons 20/25/43 of layer23 MLP carry a 'statement concluded' signal that is high when the model emits </think>. Writing an additional component along the observed decision-minus-control residual direction (u=unit(dx)) through these columns should raise P(</think>) at concluded line breaks, letting looping generations terminate and output their already-found answers.
alternatives: dx partially encodes content specific to two success contexts (only 2 decision examples)
Termination may produce wrong answers if model loops because it is unsure; accuracy may not increase
Effect may also cause premature </think> before reasoning finishes
Loop states may never activate the gate (s low), giving no behavior change
falsification: Teacher-forced: lp(</think>) at decision positions does not increase, or reference NLL on validation gold references increases >0.03. Generation: cutoff count does not fall or accuracy does not rise, or originally-correct items are lost.
